title: —Closing time, gents!
html_source: Moynihan mocks the bell (and perhaps the entire setting) with this remark, comparing it to a bar type setting when the bartender must close the bar.

anchor.prefix:
it spoke of, doubling, trebling, quadrupling its somnolent energy as the coil multiplied its ohms of resistance.
